newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-IZAWA WITHDRAWAL LETS IN ROBERTSON.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-IZAWA WITHDRAWAL LETS IN ROBERTSON.

text.p: Toshimitsu Izawa of Japan withdrew from the British Open golf championship at Royal Troon on Wednesday on the eve of the event with a finger injury.

Officials said Scottish player Dean Robertson, the first reserve after final qualifying, would take Izawa's place in a group with fellow-Scot Andrew Coltart and the 1989 champion at Royal Troon, American Mark Calcavecchia, at 0755 GMT.
